usage_note: Estonian footballer Karol Mets. Latvian press adapts the stem 'Mets' with the 1st-declension ending -s, giving 'Metss' (double s), and declines it regularly: Metsa, Metsam, Metsu, Metsā. The first name follows the same pattern: Karols, Karola. Sports copy usually uses the surname alone or 'K. Metss'. The vocative is rare in practice. | Tēzaurs morpho-api applied (agreed)
